meta.title: The Deep
meta.notes: Import after act1_00_meta.json. Contains all Act II NPC definitions, new locations, and updated faction mechanics. Act II begins the moment the player crosses into the deep forest at the end of Act I.

the_missing_person.name: [Player-defined name]
the_missing_person.role: The one you came back for
the_missing_person.personality: Changed by fourteen months inside the ruins. Still themselves, but differently. The curse has not taken them. Something else has happened to them, harder to put a name to.
the_missing_person.secret: They found the original sealing ritual in the ruins and partially performed it alone. The ritual requires a second person to complete. They have been waiting. They did not know if the player would come.
the_missing_person.note: This NPC's dialogue must reference the player-defined relationship and name from character creation.
the_missing_person.read: They go still when you look at them. They did that when they had something to tell you.

seriva.name: Seriva
seriva.personality: More dangerous than Edric. Brilliant. Has read the original texts in full. Knows the purification ritual will work and knows exactly what it costs and has decided the cost is acceptable.
seriva.secret: She was in Ashenveld twenty years ago, before the sealing failed. She knows why it failed. She is partly responsible for why it failed. She is here to correct that.
seriva.read: She talks in costs and never in names.

commander_vorne.name: Commander Vorne
commander_vorne.personality: Decisive. Pragmatic. Genuinely trying to save the region. His methods are the problem, not his intentions.
commander_vorne.secret: His daughter Issa is at the Rootless camp. She went there three weeks ago when the curse touched her and he has been pretending he does not know where she is.
commander_vorne.read: He hasn't slept. He asks questions of one word, so that he won't have to listen to long answers.

issa_vorne.name: Issa
issa_vorne.personality: Seventeen. Sharper than her father knows. Frightened of the curse and more frightened of what her father will do when he finds her.
issa_vorne.secret: She found something in the outskirts of the ruins before the curse touched her: a piece of the original sealing stone. She has been carrying it about without knowing what it is.
issa_vorne.read: She watches her father's men the way you watch weather coming in.

the_archivist.name: Pol
the_archivist.role: The camp's healer. Used to keep the Covenant's archive
the_archivist.personality: Quiet. Methodical. Left the Covenant fifteen years ago when she read something in the archives she was not supposed to read.
the_archivist.secret: She is the only living person who has read the complete original sealing text. She left the Covenant rather than participate in what it required. She has been at the Rootless camp for three years, preparing.
the_archivist.read: She counts things. Steps, leaves, your silences. She has counted you already.

ruins_watcher.name: The Watcher
ruins_watcher.role: Sits at the gate stones in Harrow wool
ruins_watcher.personality: Does not speak. Possibly cannot. Appears at intervals. Always moving away from the player, never toward. Leads somewhere.
ruins_watcher.secret: The Watcher is a person from Harrow who went east two years ago and reached a state of partial integration with the ruins that preserved their physical form while eliminating their individual will. They are being used as a guide by whatever animates the ruins.
ruins_watcher.read: Nothing in the face. But his hands are folded like a man's at a graveside.

ruins_outskirts.name: The Ruins Outskirts
ruins_outskirts.description: The outer ring of the buried city, showing as broken teeth of stone pushing up through the forest floor. There are archways that lead nowhere, and walls at odd angles. The stone is like none you know, not granite and not limestone, but darker, with a faint bloom on it like dried salt. The curse lies thick here, but not evenly, and some ways through are safer than others.
ruins_outskirts.ambient_day: The light is grey whatever the hour. Time goes differently here. It is not faster or slower, only flatter.
ruins_outskirts.ambient_night: Not a place to be at night. Something goes through the outskirts after dark that doesn't go through them by day.

ruins_marker_line.name: The Marker Line
ruins_marker_line.description: A boundary the Rootless found and marked with small cairns, beyond which the curse grows sharply stronger. The safe ways of getting through the outskirts stop working past this line. The air tastes different, and the ground sounds hollow.
ruins_marker_line.ambient_day: The cairns are still here, and somebody has been keeping them up.

ruins_inner_approach.name: The Inner Approach
ruins_inner_approach.description: This was once a road for processions; you can see it in the way the stones are laid, too deliberately spaced to be anything else. It slopes very gently down, as though the city were built partly underground and this were the way in. The walls are taller here, and some of them are still carved.
ruins_inner_approach.ambient_day: The carvings are in a script no living tradition can read. Some of them look as if they were added lately, freshly scratched.
ruins_inner_approach.ambient_night: At night the carvings give off a very faint light. It isn't enough to see by, but it is enough to notice.

ruins_source_chamber.name: The Source Chamber
ruins_source_chamber.description: A large room underground, partly fallen in and partly whole. In the middle stands the old sealing mechanism, made of stone and worked metal fused together, and once much larger than it is now. What is left of it looks broken. The curse comes off it as heat comes off a forge that is cooling: not hot any longer, but still a good deal warmer than it should be. The air is thick, and breathing takes more effort than it ought to.
ruins_source_chamber.ambient_day: You can't trust time in here. An hour may go by in what feels like minutes, or the other way about.
ruins_source_chamber.ambient_night: There is no night in the chamber. The light never changes.

crestfall_compact_post.name: Iron Compact Forward Post
crestfall_compact_post.description: The Compact has taken over the old granary on the north side of Crestfall. The doors have been strengthened, a flag put up, and three soldiers stand outside. Commander Vorne arrived two days ago, and the town has been quieter since.
crestfall_compact_post.ambient_day: Brisk and military. People keep well away from it.

ruins_hidden_passage.name: The Hidden Passage
ruins_hidden_passage.description: A way through the ruins that is on no map and in no account, and marked by no cairn. The missing person found it, and Maret suspects it is there. Neither the Covenant nor the Compact knows of it. It is the only way to the source chamber that does not go past the marker line.
ruins_hidden_passage.ambient_day: You can't see the way in unless you know what you are looking for.

ruins_gate.name: The Gate Stones
ruins_gate.description: Two standing stones and a lintel. The Watcher sits against the right-hand stone.

east_road_return.name: The East Road
east_road_return.description: The same road, walked west. There are birds in the trees again.

act2_overview.central_tension: The player has entered the deep forest. Everything they built in Act I is now at a distance. The ruins are real and dangerous and contain both what they came for and what every faction wants. The missing person is alive and changed and waiting. The factions are escalating, Commander Vorne has arrived, Seriva has arrived, and the Rootless camp is in danger.
key_decisions: Whether to go deeper into the ruins or return to Crestfall when the faction situation escalates
Whether to bring the missing person back or let them stay to finish what they started
Whether to give any faction access to the source chamber
Whether to trust Pol with what you know about the original sealing ritual
act2_overview.act_end_condition: The player must choose a faction to align with at the end of Act II. This choice cannot be reversed and determines which Act III path they take.
act2_overview.curse_spread_escalation: During Act II the curse spread value increases by 2 per scene. If it reaches 100 before the end of Act II, Crestfall is partially afflicted and the ending options change.
